report_name: Ransomware Attacks Surge 50% in Q3 2026, Fueled by Gang Rivalry

threat_actors.name: The Gentlemen
threat_actors.description: Identified as the most prolific ransomware group in Q3 2026, responsible for 383 documented attacks. The group is in intense competition with Qilin for market dominance.

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: A highly prolific ransomware group, second only to The Gentlemen in Q3 2026, with 363 documented attacks. The group's rivalry with The Gentlemen is a primary driver of the overall surge in ransomware incidents.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware groups encrypt victim data as a primary means of extortion.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Attackers employ double and triple extortion tactics, which involve exfiltrating sensitive data before encryption to pressure victims into paying the ransom.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware actors commonly delete volume shadow copies to prevent easy restoration of encrypted files, a behavior detectable by EDR solutions.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Cited as the most common initial infection vector for ransomware attacks.

indicators.name: Ransomware Note Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware Note Creation
id: 2b1a9c8d-4e5f-4a90-8bcd-ef1234567890
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a file commonly named as a ransom note by various ransomware families.
references:
  - https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/rival-gangs-vie-for-market/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-21
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - 'ransom.txt'
      - 'README.txt'
      - 'DECRYPT_INSTRUCTIONS.txt'
      - 'HOW_TO_RECOVER_FILES.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of common ransomware note files, such as 'ransom.txt', as mentioned in the article's cyber observables.

indicators.name: Tor Onion Domain Network Activity
indicators.pattern:
title: Tor (.onion) Domain DNS Query
id: 3c2b8d9e-5f6a-4b91-8cde-f12345678901
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries for .onion domains, which are indicative of Tor network usage, often associated with ransomware C2 or leak sites.
references:
  - https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/rival-gangs-vie-for-market/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-21
tags:
  - attack.t1071
  - attack.command_and_control
level: medium
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|endswith: '.onion'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects network traffic to .onion domains, which are used by ransomware groups for leak sites and C2 infrastructure.

indicators.name: Volume Shadow Copy Deletion via Vssadmin
indicators.pattern:
title: Volume Shadow Copy Deletion via Vssadmin
id: 4d3c7e8f-6a7b-4c82-8def-123456789012
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware tactic to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/rival-gangs-vie-for-market/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-21
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the deletion of volume shadow copies, a technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery, as mentioned in the mitigation guidance.
